name: claude-persist-vscode
description: Persistent Claude Code sessions that survive window reloads — chat tabs backed by a server-side daemon (code-server friendly)

Sessions run in a server-side daemon and survive window reloads.

commands.title: Claude Persist: Import Claude Code Session

claudePersist.daemonEntry.description: Absolute path to the daemon entry point (daemon/dist/main.js). Leave empty to auto-detect the monorepo layout next to the extension.

claudePersist.extraModels.description: Extra model ids merged into the model dropdown (e.g. claude-opus-5) — for models the SDK's probed list doesn't include yet. Entries the SDK already lists are ignored.

claudePersist.switchAccountOnLimit.markdownDescription:
When a plan rate limit is hit, switch to the next logged-in account (the list wraps) and continue automatically. When every account is limited, wait for whichever limit ends soonest and continue then.

Switching is daemon-wide, so it moves **every** session to the new account. Each switch also copies the session transcript into the new account's directory and starts with a cold prompt cache, so the first turn after a switch costs more.

Turn this off to keep work on one account and simply wait for its limit to reset.

claudePersist.connectionIndicator.description: Blink a border around the chat when it loses contact with the server — the browser connection or the daemon. Detected by a round-trip heartbeat, not by guessing from silence.

claudePersist.defaultModel.description: Model id applied to every new or imported session (e.g. claude-opus-5). Leave empty to use the account default.
